findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess call sites
 * @description Find all subprocess invocations to inspect argument handling
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-call-sites
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "run"]).getACall()
select call, "subprocess invocation"
findings.hypothesis: Enumerate subprocess invocation sites for potential command injection

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name dynamic code execution builtins
 * @description Find eval/exec/compile/__import__ calls
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/virtualenv-dynamic-code
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("__import__").getACall()
select call, "dynamic code execution builtin"
findings.hypothesis: Dynamic code execution builtins may be dangerous

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe dynamic execution and shell helpers
 * @description Find calls to os.system, os.popen, eval, exec and similar sinks.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/virtualenv-dyn-shell-sinks
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall()
select call, "potentially dangerous dynamic/shell execution sink"

/**
 * @name Unverified SSL context creation details
 * @description Locate calls that create SSL contexts without certificate verification.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/virtualenv-unverified-ssl-detail
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python

from Call call, string name
where
  (
    call.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() = "_create_unverified_context" or
    call.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() = "_create_stdlib_context"
  ) and
  name = call.getFunc().(Attribute).getName()
select call, "SSL context creation: " + name
findings.hypothesis: Locate unverified SSL context creation used for HTTPS downloads.
unverified SSL context used for HTTPS request (MITM risk)

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Zipfile extract calls
 * @description Find zipfile extract/extractall call sites.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/virtualenv-zip-extract
 * @tags security
 */

import python

from Call c, Name n
where
  n.getId() in ["extract", "extractall"] and
  c.getFunc() = n
select c, "zipfile extract call"
findings.hypothesis: Zip Slip path traversal in zip extraction
